newsitem.title: CANADA: UGG to resume trading at 1130 EST-TSE.
newsitem.headline: UGG to resume trading at 1130 EST-TSE.

text.p: Trading in limited voting common shares of United Grain Growers Ltd on the Toronto Stock Exchange will resume at 1130 EST, a TSE spokesman said.
"Trading in UGG shares will resume at 11:30 Eastern time," TSE spokesman Steve Kee said.
Alberta Wheat Pool and Manitoba Pool Elevators earlier Thursday offered to buy all outstanding UGG shares at C$13.75 each which prompted the TSE to halt trade.
UGG shares closed at C$12.50 each on Wednesday. The year's high was C$12.85 and low was C$6.50.
